description_excerpt: KPMG-2026-1582 About Us KPMG operates as a global network of independent member firms offering audit, tax and advisory services; working closely with clients, helping them to mitigate risks and grasp opportunities. KPMG firms operate in 143 countries and territories, collectively employ more than 270,000 people across a range of disciplines. In Vietnam & Cambodia, KPMG is one of the largest professional firms with offices in Ho Chi Minh city, Hanoi, Danang and PhnomPenh.
